cohort: 60 pregnant women at 37-42 weeks gestation with no associated medical illnesses, 30 with oligohydramnios (MVP <2cm or AFI <=5cm) and 30 with normal amniotic fluid index (>5cm).
finding: Oligohydramnios is associated with adverse pregnancy outcomes and increased perinatal morbidity.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was the most common mode of delivery (61.7%).
birth_weight: Low birth weight was measured, but specific values are not provided.
